# `oaap key`

API keys (RFC-0027) -- issue, list, revoke.

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap key [--roles ROLES] [--instance INSTANCE] [--label LABEL]
                [--days DAYS] [--kind {tenant,node,operator}] [--node NODE]
                [--grant GRANT]
                {issue,list,revoke} [name]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `name` | principal for 'issue', key id for 'revoke' |
| `--roles ROLES` | comma-separated (default `user`) |
| `--instance INSTANCE` | limit the key to one instance (recommended) |
| `--label LABEL` | what this key is for |
| `--days DAYS` | validity in days (1-365, default 90; 365 for --kind node/operator) |
| `--kind KIND` | 'node' or 'operator' make a key for the MQTT broker only (RFC-0054); NAME is then just a name (one of `tenant`, `node`, `operator`; default `tenant`) |
| `--node NODE` | for --kind node: the node's name on the wire |
| `--grant GRANT` | for --kind operator: FILTER:ACCESS, e.g. 'home/#:readwrite' (repeatable) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `issue` | yes |
| `list` | yes |
| `revoke` | yes |
